_comment: The built-in English catalog: the source of truth for every key in the application. Compiled into the binary and the wasm bundle by build.rs, so nothing can ever render blank. Deployment overrides live in <root>/locales/*.json and are merged over this at boot. Keys are dotted, sorted, and must be unique; a key ending .one/.other is a plural pair selected by count.

tax_groups.empty.detail: A document line references a group, never a tax directly. Create one for each treatment you apply.
tax_groups.empty.title: No tax groups yet
tax_groups.members_help: In the order they apply. A compound tax is charged on everything above it, so the order is part of the answer.
tax_groups.new.subtitle: Which taxes apply together, and in what order. A compound tax is charged on everything above it.
tax_groups.subtitle: What a document line points at. One group can hold several taxes, which is how a split or compound charge is expressed.
tax_groups.title: Tax groups
taxes.compound_help: Charged on the base plus the taxes before it in its group. Quebec's QST on top of GST is the usual case.
taxes.delete.confirm: Remove this tax? Only a tax in no group can be removed; everything else should be deactivated instead.
taxes.empty.detail: Add the taxes you charge. Each one keeps its own history of rates, so a reprinted invoice still shows the rate of its own date.
taxes.empty.title: No taxes yet
taxes.new.subtitle: What it is called, where it applies, and how it behaves. Its rate comes next.
taxes.rate.none: No rate yet. A document that references this tax will be refused until one is set.
taxes.rate.open_ended_help: Leave blank for open-ended, which is what most rates are.
taxes.rates.help: One window per rate, and they cannot overlap. A reprinted document shows the rate of its own date, which is why a rate change is a new window rather than an edit to the old one.
taxes.recoverable_help: Input tax that can be reclaimed, as opposed to a cost.
taxes.region_help: A state, province or district within the country.
taxes.subtitle: The taxes this workspace charges, what they are charged at, and which of them apply together.
taxes.title: Taxes
